poc = open('/workspace/poc.jpg', 'rb').read()

data = poc[idx:]
print(f'Data from SOS: {data[:50].hex()}')
# Check for 0xFF in encoded data
encoded = data[12:]  # skip SOS marker and header
print(f'Encoded data length: {len(encoded)}')
print(f'Encoded data hex: {encoded[:30].hex()}')

ff_positions = [i for i, b in enumerate(encoded) if b == 0xff]
print(f'0xFF positions in encoded data: {ff_positions}')
